items.q: What is the Assistant?
items.a: It is the part of the Studio where you describe what you need and it builds a team, an agent or a workflow for you. It asks questions, shows a plan, and builds a draft you review and save. You can still build everything by hand.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. You describe what you need to the Assistant, or you build in the Studio with names, plain-word descriptions and drag and drop. Two things do need a technical colleague: installing the Community edition on a server, and building a VibeApp of your own.

items.q: Which AI model does it use?
items.a: The one you choose: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, xAI or AWS Bedrock. You can change it later.

items.q: Where does my data go?
items.a: With the Community edition, nothing leaves your server unless you connect a service. When an AI step runs, what you send in that step goes to the model provider you chose, under its terms.

items.q: Does it replace my team?
items.a: No. It takes the repetitive work and comes back to your people for the decisions. The judgment stays with those who know the job.

decide.intro: A good service desk is not only fast. It knows what it can answer, what it must not decide, and who should take over. Here are five real cases, from a question to an expert.

problem.h2: Everyone at work has their own AI. Does your company?
body: Your people already use AI to write emails, summarise documents and answer customers. Each of them found their own way, with their own prompts and habits. Each of them gains time, but the company ends up with as many ways of doing the same task as it has people, and it cannot see any of them.

Picture one refund request in one week. On Monday, one person's assistant offers a voucher first, as the company wants. On Wednesday, another person's assistant has never heard of the voucher rule and accepts the refund. On Friday, a new team member uses a colleague's old prompt. items.q: Should a company ban personal AI assistants?

items.q: Does a shared agent use less AI than everyone using their own AI assistant?
